pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, stellate and amoeboid dark brown regions. Edges show moderate pixel gradients with notable angularity on the neck. Relative spatial area of patches increases from the neck toward the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space. Pathways are relatively thick with frequent multi-point junction nodes. Continuity is maintained across the visible dorsal and lateral surfaces.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette formed by short, dark bristles along the superior neck line.
